newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila 9-mth public sector surplus 8.8 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila 9-mth public sector surplus 8.8 bln pesos.

text.p: The Philippines posted a consolidated public sector surplus of 8.8 billion pesos in the first nine months of 1996, against an expected deficit of 5.82 billion pesos, Finance Secretary Roberto de Ocampo said on Friday.
The public sector financial position relects the financial health of the national government, the Central Bank and government corporations and agencies.
The latest public sector position figure is also higher than the 5.9 billion pesos surplus reached in the same period in 1995.
Most of the public sector surplus came from the national government, which recorded a 7.49 billion pesos surplus, de Ocampo said in a statement.
Those that also contributed to the surplus were government pension funds, government financial institutions and local government units.
De Ocampo said the public sector surplus could shrink to 3.0 billion pesos by the end of 1996 due to accelerated infrastructure spending.
